name: live-reload
body: While `kalide start` runs, changes to `slides/`, `assets/` or `kalide.yaml`, or under any resolved library layer's structure (each layer's `library.yaml` and its `slides/`, `sections/`, `themes/` and `media/` subtrees — the external library at the configured `templates:` path when the key is set AND the deck-root `templates/` directory when it exists; see external-template-library, templates-dir-layout), are detected; the resolved library and the deck are re-validated and re-rendered, and the open browser reloads automatically (see templates-live-reload). Carve-out: a change to the configured `templates:` value in `kalide.yaml` is detected but is NOT live-applied — the server stops serving the deck and shows the full-page restart-required error (see template-retarget-requires-restart) — while every other `kalide.yaml` change still live-reloads.
